Crl.Misc.No. 441/2024
                   PW-1
Witness duly sworn on 26-03-2025.
Chief Examination of PW-1 by Smt. AHS Adv. for the Petitioner
I am the petitioner No. I have filed my Affidavit in lieu of Chief 
Examination and the contents of the  said affidavit are true and correct.
 I have produced the non availability certificate dated 14-06-2024 same 
is marked as Ex.P-1.   I have produced attested copy of death certificate of 
Sutar Dyandev Gopal , the same is marked as Ex.P2 and kannada 
translatation  the same is marked as Ex.P2(A). I have produced attested copy 
of Adhar card of  petitioner No. 2,  the same is marked as Ex.P3. I have 
produced attested copy my  Adhar card ,  the same is marked as Ex.P4. I 
have produced attested copy of Adhar card of petitioner No. 3,  the same is 
marked as Ex.P5. I have produced attested copy of Adhar card of  petitioner 
No. 4,  the same is marked as Ex.P6. 
 I have produced the one daily news paper named Varta Shakti dated 
13-12-2024 where in citation is published in that paper.  The news paper 
edition of the same dated 13-12-2024 is marked as Ex.P-7.  The notice 
published where in is marked as Ex.P-7A.  
 I have produced the one daily news paper named Gadi Sanket dated 
13-12-2024 where in citation is published in that paper.  The news paper 
edition of the same dated 13-12-2024 is marked as Ex.P-8.  The notice 
published where in is marked as Ex.P-8A.  
Hence I pray to allow the petition.

..2..
Cross Examination by the Respondent.
Respondent is placed ex-parte.  Hence cross taken as nil.
Re-examination nil.  
(Typed on computer to my dictation in the open Court)
R O I & A C
Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC,
           Nippani
